'''Dana "Deke" Galvason''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] from [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] who had what some would consider a "devil-may-care" attitude towards her work.

==Biography==
A brash woman, she was among the select few who were allowed to travel through the [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|Deep Core Security Zone]] and make cargo runs to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Although she was paid well by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for her work, she was as likely to run from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]] as she was to work for it, and was not above [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as long as she could get away with it and was well [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|compensated]] for her trouble.<ref name="BatDC" />

Her personal starship was the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Bakuran Blade/Legends|Bakuran Blade]]''.<ref name="BatDC" />
